dataset_name: upay Sentinel Multi-Layer Fraud Intelligence Dataset

dataset_a_paysim.source: PaySim Mobile Money Financial Simulator (Kaggle / Edgar Lopez-Rojas)
dataset_a_paysim.format: CSV (step, type, amount, nameOrig, nameDest, isFraud, isFlaggedFraud)
dataset_a_paysim.leakage_safeguard: STRICT EXCLUSION of post-authorization balance fields (newbalanceOrig, newbalanceDest, oldbalanceOrg, oldbalanceDest) to prevent synthetic simulator artifact leakage.

dataset_b_sentinel_mfs.source: Sentinel Synthetic Bangladesh MFS Behavioral Dataset (Domain-Grounded)
dataset_b_sentinel_mfs.purpose: Customer 30-day baseline profiling and behavioral anomaly detection

dataset_c_amlsim.source: IBM AMLSim Financial Network & Typology Simulator
dataset_c_amlsim.purpose: Network graph intelligence and money-laundering pattern analysis

methodology: Two-layer feature fusion: Transaction + Behavioral/Network, real-time millisecond evaluation without future state leakage
